WE ALL SHARE BOTH, AND WE ALL MAKE A DIFFERENCE. MARY HAS MADE A DIFFERENCE IN THOUSANDS OF LIVES. DO MORE FOR YOUR COMMUNITY THAN IT ASKS OF YOU. GIVE MORE, TAKE LESS. LOOK TO THE FUTURE AND MAKE IT BETTER THAN THE PAST. DON'T BE AFRAID OF FAILURE. SUCCESS IS BUILT UPON IT. BE GRATEFUL FOR WHAT YOU HAVE, SO MANY OTHERS HAVE LESS. NEVER FORGET THAT YOU CAN AND DO MAKE A DIFFERENCE. MAINTAINING FAITH AND COURAGE, THEY ARE FUNDAMENTAL ELEMENTS THAT WILL SUSTAIN YOU. LOOK FOR THE BEST IN OTHERS AND YOU WILL FIND IT IN YOURSELF. STRIVE FOR EXCELLENCE AND STILL HOPE. EMPOWER THE RIGHT, VANQUISH THE WRONG. LOVE, CARE, NURTURE YOUR FAMILY AS IT IS A FOUNDATION OF YOUR GENERATION AND FOR ALL FUTURE GENERATIONS.
